workflow.critical: Every NFR requirement MUST have a corresponding technical solution

step.goal: Load NFR requirements and architecture context
step.action: Create a mapping table: NFR ID -> Technical Solution (initially empty)

For each NFR-PERF requirement, design the technical solution: - Caching strategy (what to cache, TTL, invalidation) - Connection pooling configuration - Query optimization approach - CDN and static asset strategy - Database indexing plan - Async processing for long operations - Response compression
Document the solution with specific technology choices and configuration

For each NFR-SEC requirement, design the technical solution: - Authentication implementation (JWT, OAuth2, session-based) - Authorization middleware and policy engine - Input validation middleware and sanitization libraries - Encryption implementation (TLS config, field-level encryption) - Rate limiting configuration - CORS policy - Security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options) - Secrets management solution (vault, env vars, cloud KMS)
Map each solution to specific OWASP mitigations

For each NFR-SCALE requirement, design the technical solution: - Auto-scaling configuration (triggers, cooldown, min/max) - Load balancer configuration - Database read replicas or sharding strategy - Cache clustering - Message queue partitioning - Stateless application design patterns

For each NFR-REL requirement, design the technical solution: - Health check endpoints and probes - Circuit breaker configuration (thresholds, recovery) - Retry policies (exponential backoff, jitter) - Backup strategy and automation - Failover mechanism - Graceful degradation patterns - Dead letter queues for failed processing

For each NFR-OBS requirement, design the technical solution: - Logging framework and format (winston, pino, structlog) - Metrics collection (Prometheus, DataDog, CloudWatch) - Distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry, Jaeger) - Alerting rules and notification channels - Dashboard specifications - Error tracking (Sentry, Bugsnag)
Compile all solutions into the template
Verify every NFR requirement has a solution mapped
